violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed (26 TAC §747.5407(a))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed
violation_type.typical_finding: During afterschool transportation and while the car was in motion, two children in care were observed hanging out the window calling out to friends and one child was observed jumping from the second row to the third row of the vehicle. Neither child was restrained in a child passenger safety seat system.

finding_variants.text: During afterschool transportation and while the car was in motion, two children in care were observed hanging out the window calling out to friends and one child was observed jumping from the second row to the third row of the vehicle. Neither child was restrained in a child passenger safety seat system.
During the investigation, it was found a child was transported without being properly and safely secured into the vehicle.
During the investigation conducted by CCI, there was a video taken by the primary caregiver which shows that children were being transported without them being placed in booster seats.
This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient. The provider transported children without using a child passenger safety seat system to an out-of-town field trip.
Child was left alone in a running car without a child passenger safety seat. The deficiency is related to a DFPS Abuse/Neglect investigation.
Three parents were called, and they stated car seats were not left at the operation days field trips were conducted.
